info.title: v2.business_insights.get_marketing_hot_listing
info.description:
Provide all metrics currently available on the Business Insights Buybox dashboard, including metrics not explicitly requested by Local (for example, CTR), covering both:

- Shop-level performance
- Product-level performance

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: End of the requested time range as a Unix timestamp in seconds. It must be greater than or equal to start_time.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Time period of the requested data. Supported values are listed below.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Start of the requested time range as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

msg.description: Business status message. The value is ok on success.

result.description: Metrics for every order type supported by the shop country. Non-COD shops return placed and paid; COD shops additionally return confirmed.

result_order_type.description: Order type represented by this entry. Possible values are placed, confirmed, and paid.

result_key_metrics.description: Shop-level summary metrics and time-series data for the order type.

result_key_metrics_key_metrics.description: Shop-level summary metrics for the requested period.

result_key_metrics_time_series.description: Shop-level metrics grouped by time bucket.

result_performance.description: Product-level performance sorted by sales in descending order.

result_key_metrics_key_metrics_sales.description: Sales amount for the order type.

result_key_metrics_key_metrics_sales_pct.description: Sales change compared with the previous period.

result_key_metrics_key_metrics_buyers_pc.description: Buyer-count change compared with the previous period.

result_key_metrics_key_metrics_orders_pc.description: Order-count change compared with the previous period.

result_key_metrics_key_metrics_units_pct.description: Units-sold change compared with the previous period.

result_key_metrics_key_metrics_conversio.description: Conversion-rate change compared with the previous period.

result_key_metrics_key_metrics_product_i.description: Product-impression change compared with the previous period.

result_key_metrics_key_metrics_product_c.description: Product-click change compared with the previous period.

result_key_metrics_key_metrics_click_thr.description: Click-through-rate change compared with the previous period.

result_key_metrics_time_series_t.description: Unix timestamp in seconds representing the time bucket.

result_key_metrics_time_series_sales.description: Sales amount in the time bucket.

result_key_metrics_time_series_buyers.description: Number of buyers in the time bucket.

result_key_metrics_time_series_orders.description: Number of orders in the time bucket.

result_key_metrics_time_series_units.description: Number of units sold in the time bucket.

result_key_metrics_time_series_conversio.description: Conversion rate in the time bucket.

result_key_metrics_time_series_product_i.description: Number of product impressions in the time bucket.

result_key_metrics_time_series_product_c.description: Number of product clicks in the time bucket.

result_key_metrics_time_series_click_thr.description: Product click-through rate in the time bucket.

result_performance_sales.description: Sales amount for the order type.

default.description: See x-shopee-error-codes and x-shopee-common-error-codes for documented error conditions.
